skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content: An alloy frame, powerful motor, and highly efficient energy consumption ensure its sturdiness, durability, and long battery life. Highly customizable accessory modules are available to best suit your demands. Raythean strives for perfection.

skins.name: SUM019.ver
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Raythean Style SUMMER Special Painting. Equipped with heat-proof coating, the latest sand wheels, and reinforced engineering. It is specially modified for operations on the beach.
skins.quote: It's even harder to tell it apart from a medical robot with this new paint job.
